name: Payments by relatives for release or "fees" for a person held abroad
description: Customers, often family members, send urgent payments abroad described as fees, fines or bail to secure the release of a relative who travelled for work, sometimes to many different recipient accounts or wallets.
fp: Genuine emergency payments for relatives in legal or medical difficulty abroad, or legitimate bail and consular costs, can look similar.

sources.text: FATF, INTERPOL and Egmont Group, Illicit Financial Flows from Cyber-enabled Fraud (2023)
FinCEN, Alert on Prevalent Virtual Currency Investment Scam Commonly Known as Pig Butchering (2023)
UNODC, Transnational Organized Crime and the Convergence of Cyber-Enabled Fraud, Underground Banking and Technological Innovation in Southeast Asia (2024)

links.name: Payments by relatives for release or "fees" for a person held abroad
links.ctx: Families of people held in forced labour at a compound may pay demanded sums; the customer can be a victim of coercion and needs a referral path rather than an exit.
